name: sd

storage.rationale: This tool has no tool-owned persistent storage in the supported Vrooli workflow; the explicit empty declaration records that caches or credentials are owned by the invoking workflow.

description: stable-diffusion.cpp (sd) text-to-image / image-to-image backend for image-tools
installHint: Installs the prebuilt CPU build of stable-diffusion.cpp (sd-cli + libstable-diffusion.so) into ~/.vrooli/opt/sd with a launcher on PATH; runs on any x86_64 host with no GPU required. For GPU-accelerated generation on a GPU host, run `vrooli host install sd-gpu` instead — it supersedes this CPU launcher with a Vulkan (Linux) or CUDA 12 (Windows) build so image-tools runs on the GPU.

targets.unsupported: stable-diffusion.cpp publishes no Linux arm64 release artifact; building the missing upstream target is outside host provisioning scope.
stable-diffusion.cpp publishes no supported macOS release artifact for this tool; building a macOS target is outside host provisioning scope.
